name: FIFA Super Soccer
desc:
The game is played as 4v4 in a packed stadium. Be the best goalkeeper, the midfield master or the star striker. Show off the best saves, deliver the assists, or score the most beautiful bicycle kicks. The choice is yours. 

CONTROLS: 
LMB - Shoot/Cross 
RMB - Low shot/Pass 
E - Slide tackle 
Q - Dribble 
TAB - Show leaderboard 
C - Unlock camera 
R - Wave (request ball) 


🎮 Made by Play! 🎮
This game used to be called Super League Soccer!
